questions.question: Why does the KPI snapshot run daily instead of weekly with the refresh?
options: Strategy's KPI API returns only the current value, so a missed day cannot be recovered
The page needs a daily headline
GitHub Actions cannot schedule weekly jobs
questions.explanation: The API keeps no history. Each day's row and raw JSON is saved to the append-only data branch or lost.

questions.question: What should an unattended job do when a new quarterly report changes the anchors every week rolls from?
options: Parse the new anchors and merge
Ignore the report until the next quarter
Rebuild the data, leave the PR open and ask a person to reanchor
Revert to the last merged data
questions.explanation: Decision O4: anchor counts come from filing sections the weekly parsers don't read, so refresh exits 2 and an issue asks for a manual reanchor.

questions.question: dat.refresh finishes every step, then finds Strategy's 10-Q for period 2026-09-30. What is its exit code and what happens to the PR?
options: 2; the PR opens but is not merged, and a "Reanchor needed" issue is opened if nothing else failed
2; merged, then an issue is opened
questions.explanation: Period 2026-09-30 is after MSTR's anchor 2026-06-30, so main() returns 2. The merge gate requires code '0', and the alert uses the reanchor title only when nothing else failed.

questions.question: EDGAR returns 404 for a filing URL. How many requests does SECClient.get make?
questions.explanation: Only 429 and 503 are in RETRY. Any other HTTP error raises at once, as test_404_fails_at_once checks.

questions.question: Why does refresh.yml dispatch ci.yml itself instead of waiting for the pull_request trigger?
options: A PR opened with GITHUB_TOKEN triggers no workflows, so CI would never run on it
Dispatching is faster than a pull_request run
The tests job only runs on main
questions.explanation: GitHub does not start workflows for events created by GITHUB_TOKEN. The job dispatches CI on the branch and waits for the run on its own head SHA, since tests is the required check on main.
